## Key Discovery: Embedded Editor is English-Only
The docs-embedded canvas-theme-editor is **always built and served with English locale**, regardless of the docs site's current locale. This is a deliberate architectural decision documented in:
- [docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts](docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts#L5): "is English-only regardless of locale"
- [docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts](docs/scripts/build-canvas-rce.ts#L28-L33): Hardcoded `locale: "en"` at scaffold time

## Locale Flow in Canvas-Theme-Editor

### Scaffolding & Build Time (packages/scaffold/)
1. **Template substitution** [src/index.ts](packages/scaffold/src/index.ts#L313-L318):
   - `locale` parameter passed to `scaffoldProject(platform, dir, options)`
   - Generates substitutions: `{ locale, dir: localeDirection(locale), ... }`
   - Substituted into HTML template: `<html lang="{{locale}}" dir="{{dir}}">`

2. **HTML Template** [templates/canvas-theme-editor/index.html](templates/canvas-theme-editor/index.html#L1):
   - `<html lang="{{locale}}" dir="{{dir}}">` — sets document language/directionality

3. **Locale-aware file generation** [scripts/generate.ts](packages/scaffold/scripts/generate.ts#L93-L95):
   - Generates `src/locale-strings.ts` with translated UI strings per locale
   - Generates `src/locale-dirs.ts` with RTL/LTR direction per locale
   - Overlays per-locale README files from l10n PO catalogs

### Runtime (canvas-theme-editor application)
1. **Initial locale detection** [templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L323-L326):
   ```typescript
   const localeLocale = (
     document.documentElement.lang || navigator.languages?.[0] || navigator.language || "en-US"
   ).trim();
   ```
   - Reads from `document.documentElement.lang` (set by HTML template)
   - Falls back to browser language preferences
   - Falls back to "en-US"

2. **Locale menu (header)** [src/main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L316-L378):
   - Creates details/summary locale picker
   - Shows available locales from `LOCALE_STRINGS` keys
   - Uses `Intl.DisplayNames` for native locale names
   - Persists to `localStorage` with key `"pantoken-canvas-theme-editor-locale"`
   - **CRITICAL**: Calls `window.location.reload()` to re-initialize app with new locale

3. **Active locale resolution** [src/main.ts.tmpl](packages/scaffold/templates/canvas-theme-editor/src/main.ts.tmpl#L546-L551):
   ```typescript
   const LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY = "pantoken-canvas-theme-editor-locale";
   const activeLocale = ((): string => {
     // ...
     return localStorage.getItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY) || "en";
   })();
   ```
   - Checks localStorage first
   - Falls back to "en"

## Constraints for Passing Locale to Editor

### Current Architecture
- ✅ Scaffolding accepts `locale` option, generates locale-specific files
- ✅ HTML `lang` attribute is substituted at build time
- ✅ Runtime locale menu allows switching (triggers full page reload)
- ✅ All locales have string overrides via `LOCALE_STRINGS` (generated from l10n catalogs)
- ❌ **No URL parameter passing mechanism** — iframe src has only cache-bust `?t=` param
- ❌ **Docs embed uses hardcoded English** — [CanvasRcePage.vue](docs/.vitepress/theme/components/CanvasRcePage.vue#L20) no locale param passed

### Build-Time Locale Localization
Files generated per locale (e.g., `vp run scaffold canvas-theme-editor my-app --locale=hu`):
1. `index.html`: `<html lang="hu" dir="ltr">`
2. `src/locale-strings.ts`: Hungarian UI strings (from l10n/hu/cli.scaffold.po)
3. `src/locale-dirs.ts`: Directional metadata
4. `src/main.ts` compiled with locale-specific strings

### Test Coverage
Tests in [packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts](packages/scaffold/tests/index.test.ts#L346-L381):
- Default locale resolves to English, `lang="en" dir="ltr"`
- Locale option drives generated markup: `lang="hu" dir="ltr"`
- Localized README overlays applied per locale
- RTL locales (ar, he) generate `dir="rtl"`
- Every platform's entry markup carries resolved lang/dir pair

## How to Pass Locale to Embedded Editor

### Option 1: URL Query Parameter (Not Currently Implemented)
- Would need to modify iframe URL construction in CanvasRcePage.vue
- Pass docs locale to canvas-rce/index.html via `?locale=...`
- Embedded app would need to read and apply via `document.documentElement.lang` on init
- **Ambiguity**: Would need to decide if localStorage persists across locale changes or resets

### Option 2: Cross-Origin postMessage API (Not Currently Implemented)
- Parent docs page could use postMessage to set locale after iframe loads
- Embedded app would listen for locale message and reload
- **Issue**: breaks iframe-height sync during reload

### Option 3: Rebuild Canvas-RCE Per Locale (Build-Time Multiplexing)
- Currently only one English build at `/tools/canvas-rce/`
- Could build 44+ versions at `/tools/canvas-rce/[locale]/index.html`
- CanvasRcePage.vue selects correct build based on docs locale
- **Trade-off**: ~40× more static assets, more CI build time

### Option 4: Preload All Locales into Single Build
- Keep single English build of canvas-theme-editor
- Embed all `LOCALE_STRINGS` + `LOCALE_DIRS` for all locales
- Use URL param or postMessage to switch at runtime
- App's `render()` function already handles string resolution per activeLocale
- **Trade-off**: ~1-2 MB additional JS payload; solves locale switching without reload

4. **String resolution**: `{ ...STRINGS, ...LOCALE_STRINGS[activeLocale] }` — missing keys fall back to English
5. **Reload trigger**: `window.location.reload()` when user picks new locale from menu
